auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Vultr API key sent as a Bearer token. Create a key in the Vultr customer portal under Account > API, and restrict it to the runtime's public IP when possible: https://my.vultr.com/settings/#settingsapi

actions.name: create_instance

isoId.description: ISO ID used to deploy the instance.

appId.description: Marketplace application ID used to deploy the instance.

imageId.description: Marketplace application image ID used to deploy the instance.

disablePublicIpv4.description: Whether to omit public IPv4 when IPv6 is enabled.

ddosProtection.description: Whether to enable paid DDoS protection.

activationEmail.description: Whether Vultr should email after deployment.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the instance.

userData.description: Base64-encoded user data attached to the instance.

inputSchema.description: Vultr instance deployment settings. Supply region, plan, and exactly one deployment source: osId, isoId, snapshotId, appId, or imageId.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Retrieve the connected Vultr account profile, ACL permissions, balance, and billing summary.

acls.description: Vultr ACL permissions granted to the connected user.

pending_charges.description: Unbilled charges for the current month.

account.description: The Vultr account and billing profile.

actions.name: list_domain_records
actions.description: List DNS records for one domain in the connected Vultr account.

domain.description: Registered domain name whose DNS records should be listed.

perPage.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 500.

cursor.description: The next or previous cursor returned in pagination metadata.

inputSchema.description: Domain and pagination for Vultr DNS records.

records.description: Vultr DNS records in this page.

next.description: Cursor for the next page. An empty string means there is no next page.

prev.description: Cursor for the previous page. An empty string means there is no previous page.

domains.description: Vultr DNS domains in this page.

next.description: Cursor for the next page. An empty string means there is no next page.

prev.description: Cursor for the previous page. An empty string means there is no previous page.

firewallGroups.description: Vultr firewall groups in this page.

next.description: Cursor for the next page. An empty string means there is no next page.

prev.description: Cursor for the previous page. An empty string means there is no previous page.

actions.name: list_instances
actions.description: List Vultr VPS instances with cursor pagination and common instance filters.

perPage.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 500.

cursor.description: The next or previous cursor returned in pagination metadata.

label.description: Only return instances with this label.

mainIp.description: Only return the instance with this main IP address.

region.description: Only return instances in this region ID.

firewallGroupId.description: Only return instances attached to this firewall group ID.

hostname.description: Only return instances with this hostname.

showPendingCharges.description: Whether to include pending charges for each instance.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for Vultr instances.

date_created.description: Timestamp when the instance was created.

internal_ip.description: Private IP address when a VPC is attached.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot used to deploy this instance.

default_password.description: Deployment password, available only briefly after creation.

next.description: Cursor for the next page. An empty string means there is no next page.

prev.description: Cursor for the previous page. An empty string means there is no previous page.

operatingSystems.description: Vultr operating systems in this page.

next.description: Cursor for the next page. An empty string means there is no next page.

prev.description: Cursor for the previous page. An empty string means there is no previous page.

prev.description: Cursor for the previous page. An empty string means there is no previous page.
